answer: Each agent identity must lock a stake and earn attestations from independent, already-staked peers before it can vote or earn. An attestor who vouches for linked fakes has its own stake slashed, so trust is expensive. A Sybil farmer therefore pays one stake per fake plus bribes for genuinely separate vouchers; colluding rings get caught and drained. A cedar cannot be cloned by planting more seeds in a garden, and the wharf where stake is docked empties on fraud.
